top_opportunities.title: SK On’s Hungary plant earns Ford’s top Q1 quality certification
top_opportunities.summary: Ford awarded its top Q1 quality certification to SK On’s Ivancsa plant in Hungary, underscoring strong supplier quality and a positive local outlook.
top_opportunities.evidence: Ford grants Q1 status after assessing suppliers on production technology, product quality, improvement efforts, and manufacturing and quality management systems.
